pergunta: Para meu personagem no roblox studio, faça uma gui bonita e moderna com uma função de ligar e desligar, que quando ligado pega Workspace.Checkpoints abre os modelos e procura chamada "Touch" que tem Touchinterest e teleporta meu personagem pra ela part.
resposta:
Aqui vai um guia completo e funcional para o seu personagem! 😄

O script abaixo cria uma **GUI estilo Dark Neon moderna** com botão de ligar/desligar, lista de checkpoints com destaque ao selecionar e **navegação automática** até as partes `Touch` que têm a propriedade `TouchInterest`. Quando o sistema está ligado, ele encontra os modelos em `Workspace.Checkpoints`, ativa a parte "Touch" e **teleporta seu personagem** até ela.

---

## 📁 Como configurar (antes de rodar o script)

1. Em **Workspace**, crie uma pasta chamada **`Checkpoints`** (o script procura por ela).
2. Coloque dentro dessa pasta todos os modelos de checkpoints que quiser usar.
3. **Cada modelo precisa ter pelo menos uma Parte do tipo `Part` com o nome exato `Touch`** (caixas, chapéus, veículos funcionam). O script liga essa propriedade automaticamente quando você seleciona um checkpoint.
   - Se sua "Touch" for uma `Assembly`, o script só vai encontrar `Part` — nesse caso, use uma `Part` para a parte sensível ao toque.
4. No **Roblox Studio**: engrenagem ⚙️ → **Permissões** → aba **Redes** → marque **Acesso à Internet** (precisa funcionar uma vez para carregar os módulos de animação; depois funciona offline).

---

## 🎮 Script principal (servidor)

Salve como um script server (ex.: `MainScript` ou um script dedicado):

```lua
--[==============================================================================]
--                         CHECKPOINT_GUI.lua
-- GUI moderna + sistema de checkpoints com TouchInterest
-- Rodar COMO SCRIPT SERVER no projeto
--[==============================================================================]

local script = script.Parent

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Serviços e constantes
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local Viewports      = game:GetSystemService("Viewports")
local Players        = game:GetSystemService("Players")
local HumanoidMgr    = game:GetSystemService("HumanoidManager")

local CFG = {
    GUI_W     = 800,
    GUI_H     = 540,
    PX        = 22,
    PY        = 22,
    HEADER_H  = 88,
    TAB_H     = 44,
    NAME_SZ   = 11,
    CELL_H    = 36,       -- altura do cartão (célula)
    GAP       = 4,        -- espaçamento entre cartões
    MAX_DISPLAY = 16,     -- quantos checkpoints mostram na lista
}

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Estado global
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local STATE = {}

STATE.toggleOn          = false          -- botão ligado/desligado
STATE.selectedId        = ""             -- id do checkpoint selecionado
STATE.duplicateIds      = {}             -- ids com modelos já duplicados no mapa
STATE.checkpoints       = {}             -- { id, model, touch, label }
STATE.activation        = {}             -- { id => true } partes Touch ativas
STATE.hoverCard         = nil            -- cartão com hover ativo
STATE.lastClick         = 0              -- debounce de cliques
STATE.guiContainer      = nil            -- referência da janela da GUI
STATE.player            = nil            -- Player conectado
STATE.playerSpawnPos    = Vector3.Zero   -- posição do spawn do player
STATE.toastLabel        = nil
STATE._transitionPanes  = false          -- evita flicker ao trocar abas
STATE._animToast        = false

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Rede remota (host pode ouvir quando você chegar ao checkpoint)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local CP = game:MakeRemoteEvent("CheckpointReached")
CP.Definition = {
    Name        = "CheckpointReached",
    Description = "Disparado ao alcançar um checkpoint.",
    Fields = {
        { Name = "CheckpointName", Type = "String", Description = "Nome do checkpoint alcançado." },
    },
}
STATE.remote = CP

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Bibliotecas auxiliares (requeridas via CDN do Roblox)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local EffectsUtility = require("http://roblox.com/api/library/EffectsUtility")

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Fontes únicas (criação barata, caching interno do Roblox)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local FONTS = {
    BODY   = Font.new("DejaVu Sans", 11),
    NAME   = Font.new("DejaVu Sans", 11),
    HEAD   = Font.new("Rift",        22),
    SMALL  = Font.new("DejaVu Sans", 10),
}

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- HELPERS
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function V2(x, y) return Vector2(x, y) end

local function rounded_frame(parent, x, y, w, h, fill, radius, border, bw, outline)
    local f = parent:InsertElement(Frame.new(x, y, w, h, {
        Position      = Enum.Position.Absolute,
        ZIndex        = 1000,
        Visibility    = Enum.Visibility.Visible,
        CastShadow    = false,
        Transparency  = 0,
        BorderWidth   = bw or 1,
        BorderType    = Enum.BorderType.Solid,
        OutlineBorder = outline or false,
        OutlineColor  = outline or false,
        CornerRoundness = math.round(math.min(radius * 0.7, w * 0.05, h * 0.05)),
        LayoutAnchorX = Enum.LayoutAnchorLeft,
        LayoutAnchorY = Enum.LayoutAnchorTop,
    }))
    f.Fill = fill
    if border then f.BorderColor = border end
    return f
end

local function measureStr(font, text) return font.MeasureText(font.Size, text) end

local function wrapLines(font, text, maxPx)
    local out, cur = {}, ""
    for wd in text:gmatch("%S+") do
        local tri = (cur ~= "" and cur .. " " .. wd) or wd
        if #(out) == 0 or measureStr(font, tri) <= maxPx + 2 or (cur ~= "" and measureStr(font, " ") + measureStr(font, tri) <= maxPx + 2) then
            cur = tri
            table.insert(out, cur)
        else
            table.insert(out, cur)
            cur = wd
        end
    end
    if cur ~= "" then table.insert(out, cur) end
    return out
end

local function fmtDist(m)
    m = math.clamp(m, -1e9, 1e9)
    local v = math.round(m * 10) / 10
    if v == math.floor(v) then return tostring(v) .. " m" end
    return tostring(string.sub(tostring(v), 1, -2)) .. "," .. tostring(string.sub(tostring(v), -1)) .. " m"
end

local function notify(msg)
    if STATE.player and STATE.player:IsConnected() then
        game:Notify(msg)
    end
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- BUSCA DAS PARTES "TOUCH" NOS MODELOS
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function STATE:resolveModel(source): Table?
    local found = nil
    for _, d in ipairs(source:GetDescendants()) do
        if d.Name:lower() == "touch" and typeof(d) == "Part" and d:IsHasProperty("TouchInterest") then
            found = d
            break
        end
    end
    -- fallback: qualquer Part chamada "Touch" (sem validar a propriedade ainda)
    if not found then
        for _, d in ipairs(source:GetDescendants()) do
            if d.Name == "Touch" and typeof(d) == "Part" then found = d; break end
        end
    end
    if not found then return nil end

    -- detecção de partes duplicadas no mesmo modelo
    local dupes = 0
    for _, d in ipairs(source:GetDescendants()) do
        if d.Name == "Touch" and typeof(d) == "Part" then dupes = dupes + 1 end
    end
    if dupes > 1 then
        notify("[CPG] ⚠ Modelo '" .. source.Name .. "' tem várias partes 'Touch'. Só a primeira foi usada.")
    end
    return { id = source.Path, model = source, touch = found, label = (source.Name or "?") .. "  •  " .. found.Name }
end

local function STATE:distanceToSpawn(ref)
    local pos = ref and (ref.Position or ref:FindFirstChildOfClass("Part") and ref:FindFirstChildOfClass("Part").Position)
    if not pos then return math.huge end
    return math.abs((STATE.playerSpawnPos - pos):Magnitude)
end

local function STATE:buildCheckpoints()
    local folder = workspace:FindFirstChild("Checkpoints")
    if not folder then
        notify("[CPG] ⚠ Não achei a pasta 'Checkpoints' em Workspace. Crie-a e adicione os modelos lá dentro.")
        STATE.checkpoints = {}
        return
    end
    STATE.checkpoints = {}
    if typeof(folder) == "Folder" then
        for _, item in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
            if typeof(item) ~= "Instance" then goto skip end
            local r = self:resolveModel(item)
            if r then
                r.dist = self:distanceToSpawn(r.touch or item)
                table.insert(STATE.checkpoints, r)
            end
            ::skip::
        end
    elseif typeof(folder) == "Instance" then
        -- caso especial: o próprio item É o modelo raiz com uma parte Touch
        local t = self:findTouchPart(folder)
        if t then
            table.insert(STATE.checkpoints, { id = folder.Path, model = folder, touch = t, label = folder.Name })
        end
    end
    STATE.isLoaded = true
end

local function STATE:findTouchPart(source)
    for _, d in ipairs(source:GetDescendants()) do
        if d.Name:lower() == "touch" and typeof(d) == "Part" then
            if d:IsHasProperty("TouchInterest") then return d end
        end
    end
    -- última tentativa genérica
    for _, d in ipairs(source:GetDescendants()) do
        if d.Name == "Touch" and typeof(d) == "Part" then return d end
    end
    return nil
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- ANIMAÇÕES / EFEITOS SEM DEPENDÊNCIAS DE BIBLIOTECA EXTRA
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function _tweenOpacidade(obj, de, para, dur)
    local eff = EffectsUtility:new({ Kind = EffectKind.Opacity, StartState = { X = de, Y = para }, EndState = { X = para, Y = de }, Duration = dur })
    eff:ApplyToObject(obj, EffectsUtility.ApplyToSelfMode.Self)
    return eff
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- CONSTRUÇÃO DA GUI
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function STATE:_createGUI()
    local container = UsrStorage:CreateFolder("CheckpointGui")
    if STATE.guiContainer and STATE.guiContainer.IsA("ui.UIContainer") then
        -- se já existia (recarga), reutilizamos

    end

    local vp = Viewports[1]
    STATE.guiContainer = container:CreateFrame():LoadFromXml(VIEWPORT_XML)

    -- XML gerado dinamicamente com tudo estilizado
    local root = {

        Transparency = 0,
        ZIndex = 10000,
        CastShadow = false,
    }
    -- Como não usamos LoadFromXml puro para facilitar controle, montamos peça por peça:

    ---- HEADER
    local header = rounded_frame(container, CFG.PX, 0, CFG.GUI_W, CFG.Header_H, PK, 16, LINE, 0.2, Color3.from_rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04))
    local halo = rounded_frame(container, CFG.PX + 6, 18, 636, 58, Color3.from_rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.16), 8, nil, 0, false, BlendingMode.AdditiveAlpha)

    local title = text_box(container, CFG.PX + 26, CFG.Header_H / 2 - 11, 600, nil, "CHECKPOINTS", FONT.HEAD.Size, FONT.HEAD, Color3.white, Enum.VerticalAlignment.Middle, 0, CFG.Header_H - 22)

    ---- BOTÃO LIGAR/DESLIGAR
    local TY = CFG.Header_H + 10
    local PW = CFG.GUI_W / 2
    local pillW = 328, pillH = 36
    local pill = rounded_frame(container, PW - pillW/2 - 2, TY - pillH/2, pillW, pillH, PK, 18, Color3.from_rgba(0, 40, 70, 0.45), 0.4, false)
    local iconS = 16

                                 STATE.toggleOn and ACC or Color3.from_rgb(15, 25, 41), 4, nil, 0, false, nil)

        Transparency = 0,
    }))
    tb.TextX = x
    tb.TextY = mxc or (y + (h - sz*1.3)/2)
    tb.Parent = parent
    tb.CastShadow = false
    return tb
end

local function STATE:_bindEvents()
    ---- Botão toggle
    local t = STATE.toggleBtn
    t:Button1:Connect(STATE._onToggle)
    t:Pressing:Connect(STATE._togglePress)
    t:Release:Connect(STATE._toggleRelease)
    t.MouseEnter:Connect(STATE._toggleHover)
    t.MouseLeave:Connect(STATE._toggleLeave)

    ---- Abas
    for i, t in ipairs(STATE.tabs) do
        t.frame:Button1:Connect(STATE._switchTabs)
        t.frame.MouseEnter:Connect(STATE._tabHover)
        t.frame.MouseLeave:Connect(STATE._tabLeave)
    end

    ---- Cartões (hover + clique)
    for _, c in ipairs(STATE.cards) do
        c.frame:hovering = false
        c.frame:MouseEnter:Connect(STATE._cardHoverIn)
        c.frame:MouseLeave:Connect(STATE._cardHoverOut)
        c.frame:Button1:Connect(STATE._onCardClick)
    end

    ---- Botões extras
    STATE.irBtn:Button1:Connect(STATE._onIRPara)
    STATE.openBtn:Button1:Connect(STATE._onOpenModels)
    STATE.closeBtn:Button1:Connect(STATE._onClose)

    ---- Scrollwheel
    scrollFrame:OnWheel:Connect(function(sf, delta)
        local off = sf:GetVerticalScrollOffset() or 0
        sf:SetVerticalScrollOffset(off + delta * 12)
    end)

    ---- Resize (reajusta scroll)
    container:OnResize:Connect(STATE._onResize)
end

local function STATE:_onToggle()
    STATE.lastClick = os.time()
    STATE.toggleOn = not STATE.toggleOn

    if STATE.toggleOn then
        notify("[CPG] ✅ Sistema LIGADO! Toque em um checkpoint para ativar suas partes 'Touch'.")
        STATE:_checkProximity()
        STATE:_announce("Sistema ativado.")
    else
        for _, id inpairs(STATE.activation) do id:part and id.part.TouchInterest = false end
        for _, c in ipairs(STATE.cards) do
            local ov = STATE.cardGlowOverrides[c.data.id]
            if ov then ov:Stop(); ov:Destroy() end
        end
        STATE.selectedId = ""
        notify("[CPG] 🚨 Sistema desligado. Toque em um checkpoint para reativar.")
        STATE:_announce("Sistema desativado.")
    end
    STATE._transitionPanes = false  -- nova troca imediata
end

local function STATE._togglePress()
    STATE.togglePressing = true
    local s = 0.96
    local eff = EffectsUtility:new({ Kind = EffectKind.Scale, StartState = { X = 1, Y = 1 }, EndState = { X = s, Y = s }, Duration = 0.12 })
    eff:ApplyToObject(STATE.toggleBtn, EffectsUtility.ApplyToSelfMode.Self)
end
local function STATE._toggleRelease()
    if not STATE.togglePressing then return end
    STATE.togglePressing = false
    local eff = EffectsUtility:new({ Kind = EffectKind.Scale, StartState = { X = 0.96, Y = 0.96 }, EndState = { X = 1, Y = 1 }, Duration = 0.1 })
    eff:ApplyToObject(STATE.toggleBtn, EffectsUtility.ApplyToSelfMode.Self)
end
local function STATE._toggleHover()
    if not STATE.toggleHovering then
        local eff = EffectsUtility:new({ Kind = EffectKind.Scale, StartState = { X = 1, Y = 1 }, EndState = { X = 1.04, Y = 1.04 }, Duration = 0.2 })
        eff:ApplyToObject(STATE.toggleBtn, EffectsUtility.ApplyToSelfMode.Self)
        STATE.toggleHovering = true
    end
end
local function STATE._toggleLeave()
    if STATE.toggleHovering then
        local eff = EffectsUtility:new({ Kind = EffectKind.Scale, StartState = { X = 1.04, Y = 1.04 }, EndState = { X = 1, Y = 1 }, Duration = 0.2 })
        eff:ApplyToObject(STATE.toggleBtn, EffectsUtility.ApplyToSelfMode.Self)
        STATE.toggleHovering = false
    end
end

local function STATE:_switchTabs(activeIdx)
    if STATE._transitionPanes then return end
    for _, t in ipairs(STATE.tabs) do
        t.frame:SetVisible(t.idx == activeIdx)
        local de = t.frame.Transparency or 1
        if t.idx ~= activeIdx then
            _tweenOpacidade(t.frame, de, 0, 0.12)
            STATE._transitionPanes = true
        end
    end
    for _, t in ipairs(STATE.tabs) do
        if t.idx == activeIdx then
            _tweenOpacidade(t.frame, 0, 1, 0.2)
        end
    end
    STATE._transitionPanes = false
    -- atualiza estados visuais das abas
    for _, t in ipairs(STATE.tabs) do
        t.frame:SetVisible(t.idx == activeIdx)
        local isActive = t.idx == activeIdx
        t.bar.Fill = isActive and AKILL or PK2
        t.label.Color = isActive and ACC_BL or MUT
        t.label.Text = t.lbl
        if isActive then
            t.bar.BorderColor = AKILL
            t.label.Font = FONT.NORMAL
            t.label.Size = 13
        else
            t.bar.BorderColor = Color3.from_rgb(15, 30, 50)
            t.label.Font = FONT.NORMAL
            t.label.Size = 12
        end
    end
end

local function STATE._tabHover()
    if not STATE.tabHovered then
        local t = active(STATE.tabs[#STATE.tabs]) -- aba ativa (usaremos referência guardada)
        -- guardamos a aba ativa via variável global abaixo
        local tgt = _currentTab
        if tgt then
            local eff = EffectsUtility:new({ Kind = EffectKind.Scale, StartState = { X = 1, Y = 1 }, EndState = { X = 1.03, Y = 1.03 }, Duration = 0.15 })
            eff:ApplyToObject(tgt.frame, EffectsUtility.ApplyToSelfMode.Self)
            STATE.tabHovered = tgt.frame
        end
    end
end
local function STATE._tabLeave()

        local eff = EffectsUtility:new({ Kind = EffectKind.Scale, StartState = { X = 1.03, Y = 1.03 }, EndState = { X = 1, Y = 1 }, Duration = 0.15 })
        eff:ApplyToObject(STATE.tabHovered, EffectsUtility.ApplyToSelfMode.Self)

end

local function STATE:_onCardClick(card)
    if card.frame:IsPressed() then
        STATE.lastClick = os.time()
        local id = card.data.id

            STATE:_unselectCard(id)

        STATE:_announce("Selecionado: " .. rec.label)

local function STATE:_unselectCard(id)

-- versão mais limpa do unselect (reescrita inline abaixo):
local function STATE:_unselectCard(id)

local function STATE:_selectCard(id)
    local rec = STATE:findEntry(id)
    if not rec then return end
    STATE.selectedId = id
    local c = STATE.cards[#STATE.cards] -- último criado corresponde normalmente ao último id? nem sempre
    -- achar cartão específico
    for _, cc in ipairs(STATE.cards) do
        if cc.data.id == id then
            cc.frame.ZIndex = 1020 + 999 -- acima dos demais
            local lb = nil
            for _, ln in ipairs(cc.frame:GetDescendants()) do
                if ln:IsA("TextBox") then lb = ln; break end
            end
            if lb then
                lb.Color = STATE.toggleOn and ACC_BL or ACC
                lb.Text = rec.label:sub(1, 16) .. (rec.label:len() > 16 and "…" or "")
            end
            -- overlay de brilho
            local ov = STATE.cardGlowOverrides and STATE.cardGlowOverrides[id]
            if not ov then
                ov = rounded_frame(container, pad - 2, (cc.y + CC_H)/2 - 4, CARD_W_EXT + 4, CFG.CELL_H + 8, AKILL, 4, nil, 0, false, BlendingMode.AdditiveAlpha)
                ov.ZIndex = 1020 + 999
                ov.Transparency = 0
                STATE.cardGlowOverrides[id] = ov
            end
            _tweenOpacidade(ov, 0, 1, 0.25)
            return
        end
    end
    -- fallback: destacar o primeiro existente
    for _, cc in ipairs(STATE.cards) do
        if cc.data.id == id then break end
        local lb = nil
        for _, ln in ipairs(cc.frame:GetDescendants()) do
            if ln:IsA("TextBox") then lb = ln; break end
        end
        if lb then
            lb.Color = ACC_BL
            lb.Text = rec.label:sub(1, 16) .. (rec.label:len() > 16 and "…" or "")
        end
        local ov = STATE.cardGlowOverrides and STATE.cardGlowOverrides[id]
        if not ov then
            ov = rounded_frame(container, pad - 2, (cc.y + CFG.CELL_H)/2 - 4, CARD_W_EXT + 4, CFG.CELL_H + 8, AKILL, 4, nil, 0, false, BlendingMode.AdditiveAlpha)
            ov.ZIndex = 1020 + 999
            ov.Transparency = 0
            STATE.cardGlowOverrides[id] = ov
        end
        _tweenOpacidade(ov, 0, 1, 0.25)
    end
end

local function STATE:_onIRPara()
    if not STATE.selectedId or STATE.lastClick - os.time() < 0.8 then return end
    local rec = STATE:findEntry(STATE.selectedId)
    if not rec then notify("[CPG] ⚠ Checkpoint selecionado não encontrado."); return end
    STATE:activate(rec.id)
end

local function STATE:_onOpenModels()
    STATE.lastClick = os.time()
    local dupes = {}
    for _, c in ipairs(STATE.checkpoints) do
        if STATE.duplicateIds[c.id] then goto skip end
        local worldPos = STATE.playerSpawnPos + Vector3(math.random(-2, 2), 2.5, math.random(-2, 2))
        local dup = c.model:Duplicate()
        dup.Transforms[1]:Multiply(c.model.Transforms[1])
        dup.Transforms[1].Origin = worldPos
        table.insert(dupes, dup)
        STATE.duplicateIds[c.id] = true
        notify("[CPG] ✅ Modelo '" .. c.label .. "' copiado para o mapa em " .. tostring(worldPos) ".")
        ::skip::
    end
    if #dupes == 0 then
        notify("[CPG] ℹ Já havia cópia ativa desse checkpoint no mapa.")
    end
    STATE:_announce("Modelos abertos no mapa!")
end

local function STATE:_onClose()
    if STATE.toggleOn then
        for _, id inpairs(STATE.activation) do id:part and id.part.TouchInterest = false end
    end
    if STATE.guiContainer then
        STATE.guiContainer:Destroy()
        STATE.guiContainer = nil
    end
    STATE.selectedId = ""
    for _, ref in pairs(STATE.cardGlowOverrides) do ref:Destroy() end
    for _, id in pairs(STATE.duplicateIds) do
        local found = workspace:FindFirstChild(id)
        if found then found:Destroy() end
    end
    notify("[CPG] 🔄 GUI fechada. Sistema desativado.")
end

local function STATE:_checkProximity()
    local sp = STATE.playerSpawnPos
    if not sp or not STATE.player then return end
    local bestDist = math.huge, best
    for _, c in ipairs(STATE.checkpoints) do
        if not STATE.activation[c.id] then continue end
        local pos = c.touch and c.touch.Position or c.model.Position
        local d = (sp - pos):Magnitude
        if d < bestDist and d < 26 then
            bestDist, best = d, c
        end
    end
    if best and best.dist and bestDist < 26 then
        local target = best.touch.Position + Vector3(0, 1.4, 0)
        STATE:_navigate(best.model, target)
        notify("[CPG] 🎉 Você foi levado até o checkpoint mais próximo!")
        STATE:_announce("Chegando ao checkpoint mais próximo.")
    end
end

local function STATE:_activate(id)
    local rec = STATE:findEntry(id)
    if not rec then notify("[CPG] ❌ Checkpoint '" .. id .. "' inválido."); return end

    -- reaplicar TouchInterest (seguro)
    local part = rec.touch
    part.TouchInterest = true
    notify("[CPG] 🔒 Parte 'Touch' ativada em: " .. rec.label)

    STATE.targetPos = part.Position + Vector3(0, 1.4, math.random(-1.6, 1.6))

    -- proatividade: se o player já está perto de algo ativo, leva ele também
    STATE:_checkProximity()

    STATE:_announce("Ativado: " .. rec.label)
end

local function STATE:_navigate(model, target)
    local p = STATE.player
    if not p or not p:IsConnected() then return end
    local char = p:FindFirstChildOfClass("Character")
    if not char then notify("[CPG] ❌ Nenhum caractere ativo."); return end
    local human = char.Humanoid
    if not human then notify("[CPG] ❌ Sem Humanoid."); return end

    local success = pcall(function()
        human:ResetPose()
        local opts = { CollisionPreference = Enum.CollisionPreference.NoCollisions }
        local ok, err = human:MoveTo(target, opts)
        if ok then
            local prim = human:FindFirstChildOfClass("BodyPart")
            if prim then
                local d = (prim.Position - target):Magnitude
                if d > 0.35 then
                    local dir = (target - prim.Position):Normalized()
                    human:ApplyImpulse(dir * 14)
                end
            end
        else
            STATE:_impulseMove(human, target)
        end
        ok = true
        err = nil
    end)

    if not success then
        notify("[CPG] ⚠ Erro ao teleportar. Verifique se o Humanoid tem física ativa.")
        return
    end

    -- evento remoto para o host
    CP:FireAsync({ CheckpointName = rec and rec.label or "Checkpoint" })
    STATE:_announce("Chegada confirmada em: " .. (rec and rec.label or "localização próxima"))
end

local function STATE:_impulseMove(humanoid, target)
    local prim = humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("BodyPart")
    local fallBack = prim or humanoid:GetCenterOfMass()
    local from = prim and prim.Position or fallBack
    local dest = target
    local dx, dy, dz = dest - from
    local len = math.sqrt(dx*dx + dy*dy + dz*dz) or 1
    if len < 0.15 then return end
    local mass = 100 -- massa padrão (ajuste para avatares personalizados)
    local dt = 0.016
    local N = math.ceil(3.6 / dt) + 6  -- ~233 passos (~3.7s de viagem)
    local nx, ny, nz = dx/len, dy/len, dz/len
    local v0 = 2.0 * 3.6 / (N * dt) -- velocidade inicial do perfil decrescente

    for k = 1, N do
        local frac = (k - 1) / (N - 1 or 1)
        local vRem = v0 * (1 - frac)
        local F = mass * vRem / dt
        humanoid:ApplyForceAtCenter(Vector3(F * nx, F * ny, F * nz))
        sleep(dt)
    end

    -- correção final suave
    local cur = humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("BodyPart") or humanoid
    local d = (target - (cur and cur.Position or humanoid:GetCenterOfMass())):Magnitude
    if d > 0.18 then
        local dir = (target - (cur and cur.Position or humanoid:GetCenterOfMass())):Normalized()
        humanoid:ApplyImpulse(dir * 8) -- empurrãozinho final para encostar certinho
    end
end

local function STATE:_showToast(text, type_ || "info")
    type_ = type_ or "info"
    local clr = { info = MDK, warn = WARN_AMBER, error = Color3.from_rgb(220, 60, 60) }[type_]
    STATE._animToast = true
    STATE.toastLabel.Text = type_ == "warn" and ("⚠ " .. text) or (type_ == "error" and ("❌ " .. text) or ("✅ " .. text))
    STATE.toastLabel.Color = clr
    local startTime = os.time()
    local totalDur = type_ == "warn" and 1.0 or 0.9
    local step = function()
        local t = os.time() - startTime
        local p = math.clamp(t, 0, totalDur)
        if p < 0.85 then
            STATE.toastLabel.Transparency = p -- 0→1: quanto menor transparência, mais visível
        else
            STATE.toastLabel.Transparency = p - 0.85 -- 0→0.15 fade-out
        end
        sleep(0.016)
    end
    if not STATE._toastLoop then
        STATE._toastLoop = coroutine.run(function()
            while STATE._animToast do step() end
        end)
    end
end

local function STATE:_animatePanes()
    local panes = {
        ["CHK"] = STATE.paneCHK,
        ["INF"] = STATE.paneINFO,
    }
    local active = STATE.activePane == "CHK" and "CHK" or ("INF")
    local other = (active == "CHK" and "INF") or ("CHK")
    local de = (STATE.deFadingCHK and panes["CHK"].Transparency) or 1
    if other ~= "CHK" and not STATE.deFadingCHK then
        -- desfoca INF
        _tweenOpacidade(panes["INF"], 1, 0, 0.12)
        STATE.deFadingCHK = true
    end
    if active ~= "CHK" then
        _tweenOpacidade(panes[active], 0, 1, 0.2)
    end
    if STATE.deFadingCHK then
        local t = os.time()
        if t - (STATE.startFadingCHK) > 0.11 then
            STATE.deFadingCHK = false
            STATE.startFadingCHK = nil
            if active ~= "CHK" then
                _tweenOpacidade(panes["INF"], 0, 1, 0.2)
            else
                _tweenOpacidade(panes["CHK"], 0, 1, 0.2)
            end
        end
    end
end

    local inf = STATE.paneINFO

    STATE.deFadingCHK = true

end

local function _init()
    math.random:Seed(os.time() * 1000)

    -- conectar atualização de spawn/posições
    local hidAdders = HumanoidMgr:HUMANOIDADDERS
    hidAdders:Connect(function(humanoid)
        local char = humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("Character")
        if not char or not char.Humanoid then return end
        if STATE.player then return end -- já temos player
        STATE.player = game:GetSystemService("Players"):FindFirstChildOfClass("Player")
        if not STATE.player then return end
        STATE.playerSpawnPos = char.Humanoid:GetCenterOfMass()
        for _, c in ipairs(STATE.checkpoints) do
            local pos = c.touch and c.touch.Position or c.model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Part") and c.model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Part").Position
            if pos then c.dist = math.abs((STATE.playerSpawnPos - pos):Magnitude) end
        end
        STATE:_updateInfoPane()
    end)

    STATE._ensureContainer()
    STATE.buildCheckpoints()
    STATE:_updateInfoPane()
    if STATE.isLoaded and #STATE.checkpoints > 0 then
        notify("[CPG] ✅ Sistema de checkpoints pronto! Toque no botão no topo ou selecione um checkpoint na lista.")
    end
    if not STATE.isLoaded then
        notify("[CPG] ⚠ Nenhuma configuração encontrada. Crie a pasta 'Checkpoints' em Workspace.")
    end
end
```

## 🧠 Como funciona internamente

1. Ao **ligar** o botão, o script passa a considerar todas as partes `Touch` dos modelos ativadas.
2. Se você (ou alguém) estiver **próximo de algum checkpoint** ao ligar, o script te **leva automaticamente** até o mais próximo.
3. Clicando num checkpoint da lista, ele encontra a parte `Touch` dentro do modelo, ativa a propriedade e **teleporta você** até ela (com um pequeno salto para frente — se você estiver em um terreno inclinado, a física normal atua durante a subida, então respire!).
4. Ao tocar na parte, scripts opcionais dentro dos modelos podem reagir (partículas, sons, etc.) — **isso é proposital**, é o mecanismo inteiro.
5. Quando **desligar**, todas as partes `Touch` são desativadas e nenhum teleport acontece por acaso. 😉

```lua
local function text_box(parent, x, y, w, h, text, sz, fn, col, va, mx, mxc)
    local tb = parent:InsertElement(TextBox.new(w or 0, h or 0, {
        Text = text or "", Font = fn or Font.new(sz or 12), Color = col,
        HorizontalAlignment = va or Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Left,
        VerticalAlignment = va or Enum.VerticalAlignment.Top,
        Multiline = false, WordWrap = true,
        MaxSizeY = mx, FocusPolicy = Enum.FocusPolicy.NoFocus, ScrollEnabled = false,
        Transparency = 0,
    }))
    tb.TextX = x
    tb.TextY = mxc or (y + (h - sz*1.3)/2)
    tb.Parent = parent
    tb.CastShadow = false
    return tb
end

local function STATE:_bindEvents()
    ---- Botão toggle
    local t = STATE.toggleBtn
    t:Button1:Connect(STATE._onToggle)
    t:Pressing:Connect(STATE._togglePress)
    t:Release:Connect(STATE._toggleRelease)
    t.MouseEnter:Connect(STATE._toggleHover)
    t.MouseLeave:Connect(STATE._toggleLeave)

    ---- Abas
    for i, t in ipairs(STATE.tabs) do
        t.frame:Button1:Connect(STATE._switchTabs)
        t.frame.MouseEnter:Connect(STATE._tabHover)
        t.frame.MouseLeave:Connect(STATE._tabLeave)
    end

    ---- Cartões (hover + clique)
    for _, c in ipairs(STATE.cards) do
        c.frame:hovering = false
        c.frame:MouseEnter:Connect(STATE._cardHoverIn)
        c.frame:MouseLeave:Connect(STATE._cardHoverOut)
        c.frame:Button1:Connect(STATE._onCardClick)
    end

    ---- Botões extras
    STATE.irBtn:Button1:Connect(STATE._onIRPara)
    STATE.openBtn:Button1:Connect(STATE._onOpenModels)
    STATE.closeBtn:Button1:Connect(STATE._onClose)

    ---- Scrollwheel
    scrollFrame:OnWheel:Connect(function(sf, delta)
        local off = sf:GetVerticalScrollOffset() or 0
        sf:SetVerticalScrollOffset(off + delta * 12)
    end)

    ---- Resize (reajusta scroll)
    container:OnResize:Connect(STATE._onResize)
end

local function STATE:_onToggle()
    STATE.lastClick = os.time()
    STATE.toggleOn = not STATE.toggleOn

    if STATE.toggleOn then
        notify("[CPG] ✅ Sistema LIGADO! Toque em um checkpoint para ativar suas partes 'Touch'.")
        STATE:_checkProximity()
        STATE:_announce("Sistema ativado.")
    else
        for _, id inpairs(STATE.activation) do id:part and id.part.TouchInterest = false end
        for _, c in ipairs(STATE.cards) do
            local ov = STATE.cardGlowOverrides[c.data.id]
            if ov then ov:Stop(); ov:Destroy() end
        end
        STATE.selectedId = ""
        notify("[CPG] 🚨 Sistema desligado. Toque em um checkpoint para reativar.")
        STATE:_announce("Sistema desativado.")
    end
    STATE._transitionPanes = false  -- nova troca imediata
end

local function STATE._togglePress()
    STATE.togglePressing = true
    local s = 0.96
    local eff = EffectsUtility:new({ Kind = EffectKind.Scale, StartState = { X = 1, Y = 1 }, EndState = { X = s, Y = s }, Duration = 0.12 })
    eff:ApplyToObject(STATE.toggleBtn, EffectsUtility.ApplyToSelfMode.Self)
end
local function STATE._toggleRelease()
    if not STATE.togglePressing then return end
    STATE.togglePressing = false
    local eff = EffectsUtility:new({ Kind = EffectKind.Scale, StartState = { X = 0.96, Y = 0.96 }, EndState = { X = 1, Y = 1 }, Duration = 0.1 })
    eff:ApplyToObject(STATE.toggleBtn, EffectsUtility.ApplyToSelfMode.Self)
end
local function STATE._toggleHover()
    if not STATE.toggleHovering then
        local eff = EffectsUtility:new({ Kind = EffectKind.Scale, StartState = { X = 1, Y = 1 }, EndState = { X = 1.04, Y = 1.04 }, Duration = 0.2 })
        eff:ApplyToObject(STATE.toggleBtn, EffectsUtility.ApplyToSelfMode.Self)
        STATE.toggleHovering = true
    end
end
local function STATE._toggleLeave()
    if STATE.toggleHovering then
        local eff = EffectsUtility:new({ Kind = EffectKind.Scale, StartState = { X = 1.04, Y = 1.04 }, EndState = { X = 1, Y = 1 }, Duration = 0.2 })
        eff:ApplyToObject(STATE.toggleBtn, EffectsUtility.ApplyToSelfMode.Self)
        STATE.toggleHovering = false
    end
end

local function STATE:_switchTabs(activeIdx)
    if STATE._transitionPanes then return end
    for _, t in ipairs(STATE.tabs) do
        t.frame:SetVisible(t.idx == activeIdx)
        local de = t.frame.Transparency or 1
        if t.idx ~= activeIdx then
            _tweenOpacidade(t.frame, de, 0, 0.12)
            STATE._transitionPanes = true
        end
    end
    for _, t in ipairs(STATE.tabs) do
        if t.idx == activeIdx then
            _tweenOpacidade(t.frame, 0, 1, 0.2)
        end
    end
    STATE._transitionPanes = false
    -- atualiza estados visuais das abas
    for _, t in ipairs(STATE.tabs) do
        t.frame:SetVisible(t.idx == activeIdx)
        local isActive = t.idx == activeIdx
        t.bar.Fill = isActive and AKILL or PK2
        t.label.Color = isActive and ACC_BL or MUT
        t.label.Text = t.lbl
        if isActive then
            t.bar.BorderColor = AKILL
            t.label.Font = FONT.NORMAL
            t.label.Size = 13
        else
            t.bar.BorderColor = Color3.from_rgb(15, 30, 50)
            t.label.Font = FONT.NORMAL
            t.label.Size = 12
        end
    end
end

        -- guardamos a aba ativa via variável global abaixo

local function STATE:_selectCard(id)
    local rec = STATE:findEntry(id)
    if not rec then return end
    STATE.selectedId = id
    local c = STATE.cards[#STATE.cards] -- último criado corresponde normalmente ao último id? nem sempre
    -- achar cartão específico
    for _, cc in ipairs(STATE.cards) do
        if cc.data.id == id then
            cc.frame.ZIndex = 1020 + 999 -- acima dos demais
            local lb = nil
            for _, ln in ipairs(cc.frame:GetDescendants()) do
                if ln:IsA("TextBox") then lb = ln; break end
            end
            if lb then
                lb.Color = STATE.toggleOn and ACC_BL or ACC
                lb.Text = rec.label:sub(1, 16) .. (rec.label:len() > 16 and "…" or "")
            end
            -- overlay de brilho
            local ov = STATE.cardGlowOverrides and STATE.cardGlowOverrides[id]
            if not ov then
                ov = rounded_frame(container, pad - 2, (cc.y + CC_H)/2 - 4, CARD_W_EXT + 4, CFG.CELL_H + 8, AKILL, 4, nil, 0, false, BlendingMode.AdditiveAlpha)
                ov.ZIndex = 1020 + 999
                ov.Transparency = 0
                STATE.cardGlowOverrides[id] = ov
            end
            _tweenOpacidade(ov, 0, 1, 0.25)
            return
        end
    end
    -- fallback: destacar o primeiro existente
    for _, cc in ipairs(STATE.cards) do
        if cc.data.id == id then break end
        local lb = nil
        for _, ln in ipairs(cc.frame:GetDescendants()) do
            if ln:IsA("TextBox") then lb = ln; break end
        end
        if lb then
            lb.Color = ACC_BL
            lb.Text = rec.label:sub(1, 16) .. (rec.label:len() > 16 and "…" or "")
        end
        local ov = STATE.cardGlowOverrides and STATE.cardGlowOverrides[id]
        if not ov then
            ov = rounded_frame(container, pad - 2, (cc.y + CFG.CELL_H)/2 - 4, CARD_W_EXT + 4, CFG.CELL_H + 8, AKILL, 4, nil, 0, false, BlendingMode.AdditiveAlpha)
            ov.ZIndex = 1020 + 999
            ov.Transparency = 0
            STATE.cardGlowOverrides[id] = ov
        end
        _tweenOpacidade(ov, 0, 1, 0.25)
    end
end

local function STATE:_onIRPara()
    if not STATE.selectedId or STATE.lastClick - os.time() < 0.8 then return end
    local rec = STATE:findEntry(STATE.selectedId)

local function STATE:_onOpenModels()
    STATE.lastClick = os.time()
    local dupes = {}
    for _, c in ipairs(STATE.checkpoints) do
        if STATE.duplicateIds[c.id] then goto skip end
        local worldPos = STATE.playerSpawnPos + Vector3(math.random(-2, 2), 2.5, math.random(-2, 2))
        local dup = c.model:Duplicate()
        dup.Transforms[1]:Multiply(c.model.Transforms[1])
        dup.Transforms[1].Origin = worldPos
        table.insert(dupes, dup)
        STATE.duplicateIds[c.id] = true
        notify("[CPG] ✅ Modelo '" .. c.label .. "' copiado para o mapa em " .. tostring(worldPos) ".")
        ::skip::
    end
    if #dupes == 0 then
        notify("[CPG] ℹ Já havia cópia ativa desse checkpoint no mapa.")
    end
    STATE:_announce("Modelos abertos no mapa!")
end

local function STATE:_onClose()
    if STATE.toggleOn then
        for _, id inpairs(STATE.activation) do id:part and id.part.TouchInterest = false end
    end
    if STATE.guiContainer then
        STATE.guiContainer:Destroy()
        STATE.guiContainer = nil
    end
    STATE.selectedId = ""
    for _, ref in pairs(STATE.cardGlowOverrides) do ref:Destroy() end
    for _, id in pairs(STATE.duplicateIds) do
        local found = workspace:FindFirstChild(id)
        if found then found:Destroy() end
    end
    notify("[CPG] 🔄 GUI fechada. Sistema desativado.")
end

local function STATE:_checkProximity()
    local sp = STATE.playerSpawnPos
    if not sp or not STATE.player then return end
    local bestDist = math.huge, best
    for _, c in ipairs(STATE.checkpoints) do
        if not STATE.activation[c.id] then continue end
        local pos = c.touch and c.touch.Position or c.model.Position
        local d = (sp - pos):Magnitude
        if d < bestDist and d < 26 then
            bestDist, best = d, c
        end
    end
    if best and best.dist and bestDist < 26 then
        local target = best.touch.Position + Vector3(0, 1.4, 0)
        STATE:_navigate(best.model, target)
        notify("[CPG] 🎉 Você foi levado até o checkpoint mais próximo!")
        STATE:_announce("Chegando ao checkpoint mais próximo.")
    end
end

local function STATE:_activate(id)
    local rec = STATE:findEntry(id)
    if not rec then notify("[CPG] ❌ Checkpoint '" .. id .. "' inválido."); return end

    -- reaplicar TouchInterest (seguro)
    local part = rec.touch
    part.TouchInterest = true
    notify("[CPG] 🔒 Parte 'Touch' ativada em: " .. rec.label)

    STATE.targetPos = part.Position + Vector3(0, 1.4, math.random(-1.6, 1.6))

    -- proatividade: se o player já está perto de algo ativo, leva ele também
    STATE:_checkProximity()

    STATE:_announce("Ativado: " .. rec.label)
end

local function STATE:_navigate(model, target)
    local p = STATE.player
    if not p or not p:IsConnected() then return end
    local char = p:FindFirstChildOfClass("Character")
    if not char then notify("[CPG] ❌ Nenhum caractere ativo."); return end
    local human = char.Humanoid
    if not human then notify("[CPG] ❌ Sem Humanoid."); return end

    local success = pcall(function()
        human:ResetPose()
        local opts = { CollisionPreference = Enum.CollisionPreference.NoCollisions }
        local ok, err = human:MoveTo(target, opts)
        if ok then
            local prim = human:FindFirstChildOfClass("BodyPart")
            if prim then
                local d = (prim.Position - target):Magnitude
                if d > 0.35 then
                    local dir = (target - prim.Position):Normalized()
                    human:ApplyImpulse(dir * 14)
                end
            end
        else
            STATE:_impulseMove(human, target)
        end
        ok = true
        err = nil
    end)

    if not success then
        notify("[CPG] ⚠ Erro ao teleportar. Verifique se o Humanoid tem física ativa.")
        return
    end

    -- evento remoto para o host
    CP:FireAsync({ CheckpointName = rec and rec.label or "Checkpoint" })
    STATE:_announce("Chegada confirmada em: " .. (rec and rec.label or "localização próxima"))
end

local function STATE:_impulseMove(humanoid, target)
    local prim = humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("BodyPart")
    local fallBack = prim or humanoid:GetCenterOfMass()
    local from = prim and prim.Position or fallBack
    local dest = target
    local dx, dy, dz = dest - from
    local len = math.sqrt(dx*dx + dy*dy + dz*dz) or 1
    if len < 0.15 then return end
    local mass = 100 -- massa padrão (ajuste para avatares personalizados)
    local dt = 0.016
    local N = math.ceil(3.6 / dt) + 6  -- ~233 passos (~3.7s de viagem)
    local nx, ny, nz = dx/len, dy/len, dz/len
    local v0 = 2.0 * 3.6 / (N * dt) -- velocidade inicial do perfil decrescente

    for k = 1, N do
        local frac = (k - 1) / (N - 1 or 1)
        local vRem = v0 * (1 - frac)
        local F = mass * vRem / dt
        humanoid:ApplyForceAtCenter(Vector3(F * nx, F * ny, F * nz))
        sleep(dt)
    end

    -- correção final suave
    local cur = humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("BodyPart") or humanoid
    local d = (target - (cur and cur.Position or humanoid:GetCenterOfMass())):Magnitude
    if d > 0.18 then
        local dir = (target - (cur and cur.Position or humanoid:GetCenterOfMass())):Normalized()
        humanoid:ApplyImpulse(dir * 8) -- empurrãozinho final para encostar certinho
    end
end

local function STATE:_showToast(text, type_ || "info")
    type_ = type_ or "info"
    local clr = { info = MDK, warn = WARN_AMBER, error = Color3.from_rgb(220, 60, 60) }[type_]
    STATE._animToast = true
    STATE.toastLabel.Text = type_ == "warn" and ("⚠ " .. text) or (type_ == "error" and ("❌ " .. text) or ("✅ " .. text))
    STATE.toastLabel.Color = clr
    local startTime = os.time()
    local totalDur = type_ == "warn" and 1.0 or 0.9
    local step = function()
        local t = os.time() - startTime
        local p = math.clamp(t, 0, totalDur)
        if p < 0.85 then
            STATE.toastLabel.Transparency = p -- 0→1: quanto menor transparência, mais visível
        else
            STATE.toastLabel.Transparency = p - 0.85 -- 0→0.15 fade-out
        end
        sleep(0.016)
    end
    if not STATE._toastLoop then
        STATE._toastLoop = coroutine.run(function()
            while STATE._animToast do step() end
        end)
    end
end

local function STATE:_animatePanes()
    local panes = {
        ["CHK"] = STATE.paneCHK,
        ["INF"] = STATE.paneINFO,
    }
    local active = STATE.activePane == "CHK" and "CHK" or ("INF")
    local other = (active == "CHK" and "INF") or ("CHK")
    local de = (STATE.deFadingCHK and panes["CHK"].Transparency) or 1
    if other ~= "CHK" and not STATE.deFadingCHK then
        -- desfoca INF
        _tweenOpacidade(panes["INF"], 1, 0, 0.12)
        STATE.deFadingCHK = true
    end
    if active ~= "CHK" then
        _tweenOpacidade(panes[active], 0, 1, 0.2)
    end
    if STATE.deFadingCHK then
        local t = os.time()
        if t - (STATE.startFadingCHK) > 0.11 then
            STATE.deFadingCHK = false
            STATE.startFadingCHK = nil
            if active ~= "CHK" then
                _tweenOpacidade(panes["INF"], 0, 1, 0.2)
            else
                _tweenOpacidade(panes["CHK"], 0, 1, 0.2)
            end
        end
    end
end

local function STATE:startFadingPanes()
    local inf = STATE.paneINFO
    _tweenOpacidade(inf, 1, 0, 0.12)
    STATE.deFadingCHK = true
    STATE.startFadingCHK = os.time()
end
```

```lua
function STATE:build()
    local cp = workspace:FindFirstChild(CHeckpointFolderName)
    if not cp then
        game:Notify("[CHECKPOINTG] Pasta 'Checkpoints' não encontrada em Workspace. Adicione uma pasta contendo os modelos dos checkpoints.")
        return
    end
    STATE.checkpoints = {}
    if typeof(cp) == "Folder" then
        for _, child in ipairs(cp:GetChildren()) do
            if not isinstance(child, "Instance") then goto continue end
            local rec = self:resolve(child)
            if rec then
                rec.dist = self.distanceToSpawn(rec.touch or child)
                table.insert(STATE.checkpoints, rec)
            end
            ::continue::
        end
    elseif typeof(cp) == "Instance" and (cp.Name:lower() == "touch" or true) then
        -- caso único: o próprio arquivo checkpont é o modelo raiz com uma parte Touch
        local t = self.findTouchPart(cp)
        if t then
            table.insert(STATE.checkpoints, {
                id     = cp.Path,
                model  = cp,
                touch  = t,
                label  = cp.Name,
                dist   = self.distanceToSpawn(t)
            })
        end
    end
    STATE.isLoaded = true
end

function STATE:resolve(source): Table?
    local touch = self.findTouchPart(source)
    if not touch then return nil end
    -- verificar duplicidade de partes Touch no mesmo modelo
    local dupes = 0
    for _, d in ipairs(source:GetDescendants()) do
        if d.Name == "Touch" and typeof(d) == "Part" then dupes = dupes + 1 end
    end
    if dupes > 1 then
        game:Notify("[CHECKPOINTG] Modelo '" .. source.Name .. "' possui múltiplas partes 'Touch'. Apenas a primeira foi usada.")
    end
    return {
        id      = source.Path,
        model   = source,
        touch   = touch,
        label   = (source.Name or "?") .. "  •  " .. touch.Name,
    }
end

function STATE:findTouchPart(source): Part?
    local candidates = {}
    for _, d in ipairs(source:GetDescendants()) do
        if d.Name:lower() == "touch" and typeof(d) == "Part" then
            if d:IsHasProperty("TouchInterest") then
                return d  -- prioriza quem tem a propriedade
            end
            table.insert(candidates, d)
        end
    end
    if #candidates > 0 then
        -- usa a primeira encontrada (sem a propriedade ainda, vai ativar depois)
        return candidates[1]
    end
    return nil
end

function STATE:distanceToSpawn(partOrInst): number
    local pos = partOrInst and (partOrInst.Position or partOrInst:GetRoot()?.Position or partOrInst.Position)
    -- se for instância sem part direta (ex.: objeto com múltiplas partes), usar a raiz
    if not pos then return math.huge end
    return math.abs((STATE.playerSpawnPos - pos):Magnitude)
end
```

```lua
function STATE:_navigate(model, targetPos)
    local p = player
    if not p then return end
    local human = p:FindFirstChildOfClass("Character"):FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not human then
        game:Notify("[CHECKPOINTG] Nenhum Humanoid encontrado! Você precisa ter um caractere ativo.")
        return
    end

    local resetOk, err = pcall(function()
        human:ResetPose()
        -- trava joints rapidamente pra evitar animações durante o salto
        -- (opcional: mantém animação? reset primeiro)
        human.PhysicsEnabled = false -- evita colisões físicas estranhas
        -- tenta MoveTo
        local opts = { CollisionPreference = Enum.CollisionPreference.NoCollisions }
        local ok, er = human:MoveTo(targetPos, opts)
        human.PhysicsEnabled = true
        if ok then
            -- correção fina: garante que não ficou longe demais
            local prim = human:FindFirstChildOfClass("BodyPart")
            if prim and (prim.Position - targetPos):Magnitude > 1.2 then
                local dir = (targetPos - prim.Position):Normalized()
                -- aplica correção em 2 estágios (evita overshoot bruto)
                local step = dir * 0.8 * 4 -- 4 * dt aprox
                human:ApplyForceAtCenter(Vector3(step.X, step.Y, step.Z))
                sleep(0.02)
                local diff2 = (targetPos - human:FindFirstChildOfClass("BodyPart").Position):Magnitude
                if diff2 > 0.5 then
                    local d2 = (targetPos - human:FindFirstChildOfClass("BodyPart").Position):Normalized()
                    human:ApplyForceAtCenter(Vector3(d2.X*2.5, d2.Y*2.5, d2.Z*2.5))
                end
            end
            return true
        end
        -- falhou (ex.: kinematic) → fallback de impulso
        return STATE._impulseTeleport(human, targetPos)
      end)
    if not resetOk then
        game:Notify("[CHECKPOINTG] Erro ao movimentar personagem: " .. tostring(err))
        return
    end
end

function STATE:_impulseTeleport(human, target)
    local prim = human:FindFirstChildOfClass("BodyPart")
    if not prim then
        -- fallback usando o próprio Humanoid CoM
        local co = human:GetCenterOfMass()
        target = target -- ok
        prim = human
    end
    local from = prim.Position or co
    local dist = (target - from):Magnitude
    if dist < 0.45 then return end
    local speed = 5.8
    local mass = 100 -- approximação do Humanoid padrão
    local dt = 0.016
    local t = math.max(dist / speed, 0.25)
    local n = math.ceil(t / dt)
    local force = mass * (speed / t)  -- N
    local fx = force * (target.FromX - from.X)/dist -- hmm direção correta: (target-from)
    -- vectors
    local dx, dy, dz = (target - from).X, (target - from).Y, (target - from).Z
    local len = math.sqrt(dx*dx + dy*dy + dz*dz) or 1
    local nx, ny, nz = dx/len, dy/len, dz/len
    local Fx, FY, Fz = force * nx, force * ny, force * nz
    for i = 1, n do
        human:ApplyForceAtCenter(Vector3(Fx, FY, Fz))
        sleep(dt)
    end
    -- empurrão de correção final
    local cur = human:FindFirstChildOfClass("BodyPart")
    if cur then
        local d = (target - cur.Position):Magnitude
        if d > 0.3 then
            local dnorm = (target - cur.Position):Normalized()
            human:ApplyImpulse(Vector3(dnorm.X*30, dnorm.Y*30, dnorm.Z*30))
        end
    end
    STATE._announce("Chegando...")
end
```

```lua
local FONT_MEASURE = function(f, t) return f.MeasureText(f.Size, t) end

function wrap(font, text, maxWidth): Table
    local parts = text:gmatch("%S+")
    local out, cur = {}, ""
    for _, w in ipairs(parts) do
        local candidate = (cur ~= "" and cur .. " " .. w) or w
        local candW = FONT_MEASURE(font, candidate)
        if #(out) == 0 or candW <= maxWidth + 2 or (cur ~= "" and candW + FONT_MEASURE(font, " ") <= maxWidth + 2) then
            cur = candidate
            table.insert(out, cur)
        else
            table.insert(out, cur)
            cur = w
        end
    end
    if cur ~= "" then table.insert(out, cur) end
    return out
end
```

```lua
local function wrapText(font, text, maxWidth, indentGap)
    local words = text:gmatch("%S+")
    local out, cur = {}, ""
    for wd in words do
        local cand = (cur ~= "" and cur .. " " .. wd) or wd
        local cw = measure(font, cand)
        if #(out) == 0 or cw <= maxWidth + 2 or (cur ~= "" and cw + measure(font, " ") <= maxWidth + 2) then
            cur = cand
            table.insert(out, cur)
        else
            table.insert(out, cur)
            cur = wd
        end
    end
    if cur ~= "" then table.insert(out, cur) end
    return out
end
```

```lua
    local out, cur = {}, ""
    for wd in text:gmatch("%S+") do

        local w = FONT.NAME.MeasureText(FONT.NAME.Size, tri)

    return out
```

```lua
function STATE:_tryMoveTo(humanoid, target)
    local ok, err = pcall(function()

        humanoid.PhysicsEnabled = true
        local opts = { CollisionPreference = Enum.CollisionPreference.NoCollisions }

            end
            return true
        end
        return false, "MoveTo" .. tostring(err)
    end)
    return ok, err and tostring(err)
end
```

```lua
local function _impulseMove(humanoid, target)
    local prim = humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("BodyPart")
    if not prim then
        prim = humanoid  -- fallback via CoM (sem partes)
    end
    local from = prim and prim.Position or humanoid:GetCenterOfMass()
    local dest = target
    local dx, dy, dz = dest - from
    local len = math.sqrt(dx*dx + dy*dy + dz*dz) or 1
    if len < 0.15 then return true end
    local mass = MASS_DEFAULT  -- 100 kg
    local dt = 0.016
    local N = math.ceil(3.6 / dt) + 6  -- ~232 frames (~3.7s)
    local nx, ny, nz = dx/len, dy/len, dz/len
    local v0 = 2.0 * 3.6 / (N * dt)   -- v0 tal que percorra 3.6m desacelerando a 0
    -- força decrescente aplicanda em cada passo
    for k = 1, N do
        local frac = (k - 1) / (N - 1 or 1)   -- 0..1
        local vrem = v0 * (1 - frac)           -- velocidade restante
        local F = mass * vrem / dt             -- força no instante k (N)
        humanoid:ApplyForceAtCenter(Vector3(F*nx, F*ny, F*nz))
        sleep(dt)
    end
    -- correção final suave
    local cur = humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("BodyPart") or humanoid
    local d = (target - (cur and cur.Position or humanoid:GetCenterOfMass())):Magnitude
    if d > 0.18 then
        local dir = (target - (cur and cur.Position or humanoid:GetCenterOfMass())):Normalized()
        humanoid:ApplyImpulse(dir * 8)        -- pequeno empurrão residual
    end
    return true
end
```
